cases.description: A staged payload contains a synthetic private-key block or OpenBao token marker.
A lockfile component declares an unknown or missing license.
The complete package is requested without a built engine binary.

A real file-size limit aborts staging; the prior release remains complete and the next run recovers.
A second live writer is rejected explicitly and cannot publish a partial release.
Repeating packaging produces identical checksums and no duplicate nested release or staging entries.
No .local-data, provider state, runtime credential or plaintext is embedded; provider images remain pinned external digests.
